compiled_state.title: ci-llm-review: schema correction budget of 2 exhausted on large diffs -> fail-closed merge block
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Incident Overview

When Strategy F (chunked review for large diffs) activates, the LLM sometimes produces malformed JSON. The schema correction budget is 2 attempts. When both fail, the runner exits with fail-closed: 'schema correction exhausted all 2 attempts -- synthetic schema_error present; blocking merge'. Additionally, code-reviewer-deep-verification returns non-JSON responses (108-113 bytes of prose) that exhaust the fallback chain.

**Observed on**: PRs #365, #372, #376, #379
**Impact**: Intermittent hard block on large PRs requiring admin bypass

comments.body: Classification: behavioral, Score: 6 (ADVANCED). Severity=2(high), Complexity=1(moderate), Environment=1(CI), Intermittent=2(observed). The schema correction failures are intermittent - same PR type sometimes passes.
comments.author: Test

comments.body: Investigation complete (ADVANCED, convergence_score=2). Both agents agree: schema correction sends the full original diff to Haiku on Strategy F paths. Haiku cannot reliably produce structured JSON on large inputs. Retry loop uses identical parameters (deterministic failure). Strategy F was added May 19 after schema correction was wired May 13, without updating the correction model. Fix: (1) strip diff from correction prompt for field-level errors, (2) upgrade correction model to Sonnet when Strategy F active.
